in_sanskrit.name: Alfaiz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon's Calf
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alfaiz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Alfaiz is derived from the Arabic word 'alf', meaning 'one' and the Persian word 'faz', meaning 'calf'. The name is believed to be given to a child born under the crescent moon, symbolizing the beginning of a new life.
